title: WikiIndexDocumentUpsertedPayload
description: wiki.index_document.upserted v1 (OpenVibe.Wiki server/wiki/service.js sync, via openvibe-publishing/index-hooks indexEvent). The OpenVibe.Search document of a published, public, listable page, sent whenever what Search should hold changed (the revision grows with every change). Consumed by OpenVibe.Search ('*.index_document.*'). Envelope: subject { type: page, id, revision: <document revision> }, visibility internal, priority important, actor service:wiki.
